value: The army crosses the Delaware as one symbol and divides on the New Jersey bank into Greene's and Sullivan's divisions; Greene, Sullivan and Knox's artillery are drawn whole until the first shots, then as their brigades and batteries. Formations, in the Layers menu, draws them whole again when zoomed out. Routes taken, also in Layers, draws the roads each unit has marched. The escapes (the dragoons to Princeton, the jägers to Bordentown, about fifty of the Knyphausen regiment to Crosswicks) follow roads the sources do not give.
